mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_LOST_ITEMS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO LOST_ITEMS ( LOST_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY_ID, ITEM_NAME, COLOR, BRAND, LOST_LOCATION_ID, LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL, LOST_DATE, LOST_TIME, LOST_TIME_RANGE, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{lostId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{categoryId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{itemName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{color,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{brand,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lostLocationId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{lostLocationDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lostDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{lostTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lostTimeRange,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_FOUND_ITEMS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO FOUND_ITEMS ( FOUND_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY_ID, ITEM_NAME, COLOR, BRAND, FOUND_LOCATION_ID, FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL, FOUND_DATE, FOUND_TIME, FOUND_TIME_RANGE, STORAGE_ID, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{foundId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{categoryId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{itemName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{color,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{brand,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{foundLocationId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{foundLocationDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{foundDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{foundTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{foundTimeRange,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{storageId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{description,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOST_ITEMS L LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = L.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID

SELECT L.LOST_ID AS ID, L.USER_ID, 'lost' AS ITEM_TYPE, L.TITLE, L.CATEGORY_ID, C.CATEGORY_NAME, L.ITEM_NAME, L.COLOR, L.BRAND, L.LOST_LOCATION_ID AS LOCATION_ID, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, L.LOST_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, L.LOST_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, L.LOST_TIME_RANGE AS ITEM_TIME_RANGE, NULL AS STORAGE_ID, NULL AS STORAGE_NAME, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(L.DESCRIPTION, 4000, 1) AS DESCRIPTION, L.STATUS, L.VIEW_COUNT, L.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NAME AS WRITER_NAME, U.STUDENT_NO, NULL AS SCHOOL, IMG.IMAGE_URL FROM LOST_ITEMS L JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = L.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = L.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORDER, 9999), IMAGE_ID) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'lost' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_ID = L.LOST_ID WHERE L.LOST_ID = #{lostId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND L.STATUS != 'DELETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOUND_ITEMS F LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = F.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID

SELECT F.FOUND_ID AS ID, F.USER_ID, 'found' AS ITEM_TYPE, F.TITLE, F.CATEGORY_ID, C.CATEGORY_NAME, F.ITEM_NAME, F.COLOR, F.BRAND, F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID AS LOCATION_ID, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, F.FOUND_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, F.FOUND_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, F.FOUND_TIME_RANGE AS ITEM_TIME_RANGE, F.STORAGE_ID, SP.STORAGE_NAME, SP.LOCATION_ID AS STORAGE_LOCATION_ID, SL.LOCATION_NAME AS STORAGE_LOCATION_NAME, SL.LATITUDE AS STORAGE_LATITUDE, SL.LONGITUDE AS STORAGE_LONGITUDE, SP.MANAGER_NAME AS STORAGE_MANAGER_NAME, SP.PHONE AS STORAGE_PHONE, SP.OPERATING_HOURS AS STORAGE_OPERATING_HOURS, SP.DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_DESCRIPTION, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(F.DESCRIPTION, 4000, 1) AS DESCRIPTION, F.STATUS, F.VIEW_COUNT, F.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NAME AS WRITER_NAME, U.STUDENT_NO, NULL AS SCHOOL, IMG.IMAGE_URL FROM FOUND_ITEMS F JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = F.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = F.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN STORAGE_PLACES SP ON SP.STORAGE_ID = F.STORAGE_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS SL ON SL.LOCATION_ID = SP.LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORDER, 9999), IMAGE_ID) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'found' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_ID = F.FOUND_ID WHERE F.FOUND_ID = #{foundId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND F.STATUS != 'DELETED'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT L.LOST_ID AS ID, 'lost' AS ITEM_TYPE, L.TITLE, L.ITEM_NAME, L.STATUS, L.CREATED_AT, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL FROM LOST_ITEMS L LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID WHERE #{itemType} = 'lost' AND L.STATUS NOT IN ('DELETED', 'HIDDEN') UNION ALL SELECT F.FOUND_ID AS ID, 'found' AS ITEM_TYPE, F.TITLE, F.ITEM_NAME, F.STATUS, F.CREATED_AT, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL FROM FOUND_ITEMS F LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID WHERE #{itemType} = 'found' AND F.STATUS NOT IN ('DELETED', 'HIDDEN') ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT L.LOST_ID AS ID, L.USER_ID, 'lost' AS ITEM_TYPE, L.TITLE, L.CATEGORY_ID, C.CATEGORY_NAME, L.ITEM_NAME, L.COLOR, L.BRAND, L.LOST_LOCATION_ID AS LOCATION_ID, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, L.LOST_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, L.LOST_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, L.LOST_TIME_RANGE AS ITEM_TIME_RANGE, NULL AS STORAGE_ID, NULL AS STORAGE_NAME, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(L.DESCRIPTION, 1000, 1) AS DESCRIPTION, L.STATUS, L.VIEW_COUNT, L.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NAME AS WRITER_NAME, U.STUDENT_NO, NULL AS SCHOOL, IMG.IMAGE_URL FROM LOST_ITEMS L JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = L.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = L.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORDER, 9999), IMAGE_ID) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'lost' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_ID = L.LOST_ID WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND L.STATUS NOT IN ('DELETED', 'HIDDEN') ORDER BY L.CREATED_AT DESC )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT F.FOUND_ID AS ID, F.USER_ID, 'found' AS ITEM_TYPE, F.TITLE, F.CATEGORY_ID, C.CATEGORY_NAME, F.ITEM_NAME, F.COLOR, F.BRAND, F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID AS LOCATION_ID, LOC.LOCATION_NAME, F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL AS LOCATION_DETAIL, F.FOUND_DATE AS ITEM_DATE, F.FOUND_TIME AS ITEM_TIME, F.FOUND_TIME_RANGE AS ITEM_TIME_RANGE, F.STORAGE_ID, SP.STORAGE_NAME, SP.LOCATION_ID AS STORAGE_LOCATION_ID, SL.LOCATION_NAME AS STORAGE_LOCATION_NAME, SL.LATITUDE AS STORAGE_LATITUDE, SL.LONGITUDE AS STORAGE_LONGITUDE, SP.MANAGER_NAME AS STORAGE_MANAGER_NAME, SP.PHONE AS STORAGE_PHONE, SP.OPERATING_HOURS AS STORAGE_OPERATING_HOURS, SP.DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_DESCRIPTION, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(F.DESCRIPTION, 1000, 1) AS DESCRIPTION, F.STATUS, F.VIEW_COUNT, F.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NAME AS WRITER_NAME, U.STUDENT_NO, NULL AS SCHOOL, IMG.IMAGE_URL FROM FOUND_ITEMS F JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = F.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = F.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN STORAGE_PLACES SP ON SP.STORAGE_ID = F.STORAGE_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS SL ON SL.LOCATION_ID = SP.LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORDER, 9999), IMAGE_ID) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'found' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_ID = F.FOUND_ID WHERE F.USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND F.STATUS NOT IN ('DELETED', 'HIDDEN') ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.REPORTER_ID, U.USER_NAME AS REPORTER_NAME, R.TARGET_TYPE, R.TARGET_ID, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN (SELECT USER_ID FROM LOST_ITEMS WHERE LOST_ID = R.TARGET_ID) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN (SELECT USER_ID FROM FOUND_ITEMS WHERE FOUND_ID = R.TARGET_ID) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'chat' THEN R.TARGET_ID ELSE NULL END AS TARGET_USER_ID, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN ( SELECT LU.USER_NAME FROM LOST_ITEMS LI JOIN USERS LU ON LU.USER_ID = LI.USER_ID WHERE LI.LOST_ID = R.TARGET_ID ) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN ( SELECT FU.USER_NAME FROM FOUND_ITEMS FI JOIN USERS FU ON FU.USER_ID = FI.USER_ID WHERE FI.FOUND_ID = R.TARGET_ID ) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'chat' THEN (SELECT CU.USER_NAME FROM USERS CU WHERE CU.USER_ID = R.TARGET_ID) ELSE NULL END AS TARGET_USER_NAME, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN (SELECT TITLE FROM LOST_ITEMS WHERE LOST_ID = R.TARGET_ID) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN (SELECT TITLE FROM FOUND_ITEMS WHERE FOUND_ID = R.TARGET_ID) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'chat' THEN (SELECT USER_NAME || '님과의 채팅' FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = R.TARGET_ID) ELSE NULL END AS TARGET_TITLE, R.REASON, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(R.DETAIL, 1000, 1) AS DETAIL, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.PROCESSED_AT FROM REPORTS R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.REPORTER_ID
AND ( R.REASON LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(R.DETAIL, #{keyword}) > 0 OR LOWER(U.USER_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND R.STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200

SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.REPORTER_ID, U.USER_NAME AS REPORTER_NAME, R.TARGET_TYPE, R.TARGET_ID, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN (SELECT USER_ID FROM LOST_ITEMS WHERE LOST_ID = R.TARGET_ID) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN (SELECT USER_ID FROM FOUND_ITEMS WHERE FOUND_ID = R.TARGET_ID) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'chat' THEN R.TARGET_ID ELSE NULL END AS TARGET_USER_ID, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN (SELECT TITLE FROM LOST_ITEMS WHERE LOST_ID = R.TARGET_ID) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN (SELECT TITLE FROM FOUND_ITEMS WHERE FOUND_ID = R.TARGET_ID) WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'chat' THEN (SELECT USER_NAME || '님과의 채팅' FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = R.TARGET_ID) ELSE NULL END AS TARGET_TITLE, R.REASON, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(R.DETAIL, 1000, 1) AS DETAIL, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.PROCESSED_AT FROM REPORTS R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.REPORTER_ID WHERE R.REPORT_ID = #{reportId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.update: UPDATE LOST_ITEMS SET TITLE = #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ITEM_NAME = #{itemName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COLOR = #{color,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BRAND = #{brand,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LOST_LOCATION_ID = #{lostLocationId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL = #{lostLocationDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LOST_DATE = #{lostDate,jdbcType=DATE}, LOST_TIME = #{lostTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LOST_TIME_RANGE = #{lostTimeRange,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DESCRIPTION = #{description,jdbcType=CLOB}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LOST_ID = #{lostId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'

UPDATE FOUND_ITEMS SET TITLE = #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ITEM_NAME = #{itemName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COLOR = #{color,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BRAND = #{brand,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FOUND_LOCATION_ID = #{foundLocationId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL = #{foundLocationDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FOUND_DATE = #{foundDate,jdbcType=DATE}, FOUND_TIME = #{foundTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FOUND_TIME_RANGE = #{foundTimeRange,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STORAGE_ID = #{storageId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DESCRIPTION = #{description,jdbcType=CLOB}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE FOUND_ID = #{foundId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'
